बॉलीवुड के किंग यानी Shah Rukh Khan के जन्मदिन पर Kareena Kapoor Khan ने फैंस को एक ज़बरदस्त सरप्राइज दे दिया है! 👑

Kareena ने अपने Instagram पर Shah Rukh Khan के 61वें जन्मदिन पर दोनों की एक डांस-थीम्ड ब्लैक-एंड-व्हाइट फोटो शेयर की। उन्होंने कैप्शन में संकेत दिया कि 24 दिसंबर 2026 को कुछ खास आने वाला है। रिपोर्ट्स के मुताबिक, दोनों आने वाली फिल्म King में एक स्पेशल गाने के लिए साथ आ रहे हैं। 💃🕺

Siddharth Anand द्वारा निर्देशित इस फिल्म में Suhana Khan, Abhishek Bachchan, Jackie Shroff, Arshad Warsi और Raghav Juyal नज़र आएंगे। वहीं Rani Mukerji, Deepika Padukone और Kareena Kapoor का फिल्म में स्पेशल अपीयरेंस होगा। 2023 में Dunki के बाद बड़े पर्दे पर यह SRK की अगली बड़ी रिलीज़ होगी। 💥

क्या आप पर्दे पर Shah Rukh Khan और Kareena Kapoor की इस जोड़ी को दोबारा साथ देखने के लिए उत्सुक हैं? कमेंट्स में अपनी राय ज़रूर लिखें! 👇

ctx.title: Kareena Kapoor teases reunion with Shah Rukh Khan in King with dance-themed photo, calls him ‘forever ruler of the kingdom’
ctx.summary: Kareena Kapoor's post after the makers of King released the film's first song, Tu Mil Jaaye, featuring Shah Rukh Khan and Deepika Padukone on November 2.
ctx.text:
Kareena Kapoor has given Shah Rukh Khan fans another reason to look forward to King. Sharing a picture of the two actors together, Kareena hinted at something special coming up on December 24, 2026. While she hasn't spelt out what the surprise is, reports have already suggested that the two stars will reunite for a special song in the upcoming film. The post comes just as the makers of King build anticipation around the film.
Kareena posted a black-and-white silhouette of herself and Shah Rukh on Instagram. The two appear to be facing each other, seemingly about to break into a dance, with dramatic lights in the background. The picture reveals very little, but it's been enough to get fans wondering when the song will be out. They have previously shared screen space in films such as Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham, Ra.One, Asoka and a special song in Don.
Sharing the picture on his 61st birthday, Kareena wished the superstar and dropped what could be a hint about their next collaboration. She wrote: “Happy Birthday King 👑 The forever Ruler of the kingdom ⭐ Let’s dance together… 💃🕺 Can’t wait 🎉 24-12-26 💖.”
December 24 will mark Shah Rukh Khan's return to theatres with King, his first big-screen release since Dunki in 2023. The actor had a memorable year in 2023, with three releases: Pathaan, Jawan and Dunki. This time, he is returning with a large ensemble cast that includes Suhana Khan, Abhishek Bachchan, Jackie Shroff, Arshad Warsi and Raghav Juyal among others. Rani Mukerji, Deepika Padukone and Kareena Kapoor Khan will also make special appearances in the film.
Adding to the excitement, the makers released the film's first song, Tu Mil Jaaye , featuring Shah Rukh and Deepika, at midnight on November 2. Sharing the song on social media, Shah Rukh wrote, “This era of love is bestowed upon the fortunate ones... Where roses bloom amidst the fragrance of gunpowder…Of Love and other Battles…This December, #LoveLikeAKing #TuMilJaaye song out now! #KING in cinemas 24.12.26.” The song release comes a week after the makers unveiled a new poster of the film, giving fans another glimpse into the world of King.
King, directed by Siddharth Anand, is backed by Gauri Khan's Red Chillies Entertainment and by Siddharth and Mamta Anand's Marflix Pictures. The film is reportedly inspired by the 1994 French film Léon: The Professional, starring Jean Reno. It is said to follow the relationship between an ageing, feared assassin, played by Shah Rukh, and his young protégé, portrayed by his daughter Suhana.
